description: This file defines the Redis session management class for the Opencart system, providing methods to read, write, destroy, and manage session data stored in a Redis backend.

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: A class for handling session data storage in Redis within the Opencart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection and sets the session prefix based on configuration.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from Redis by session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to Redis by session ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes a session from Redis by session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Garbage collection method; Redis handles expiration, so this is a no-op.
